Package foms.models

Class Order

java.lang.Object
foms.models.Order
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Order extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an order within the Food Order Management System. The class encapsulates details such as order ID, status, associated items, and costs. It also tracks the order's progress through timestamps for pickup and collection.
Since:
2024-04-15
